verdict.rationale: Nix supports isolated, reproducible environments (nix-shell, nix develop) and 'reproducible integration testing using virtual machines,' which can function as sandboxes separate from a production system, and per-user profiles avoid touching other environments. However, there is no evidence of an AI-native workflow, explicit production-data isolation, or agent-oriented sandbox tooling — this is a generic dev-environment/VM testing feature, not a purpose-built AI sandbox. Missing for 10: explicit production-data isolation guarantees, AI-agent integration or use-case documentation, and independent verification of VM-based test sandboxing in practice.
